full_source.description: all five sources' admitted pools; every case

sor_compatible.description: pools whose source has a Uniswap SOR protocol (V2/V3; Liquidity Book has none); a case unreachable in this pool graph is `unsupported` for SOR, never `no_route`

envelope.rule: E(token) = ceil(2 x max case notional USD / price(token)) raw units, both directions of every admitted pool

rule.text: a discovered pool is excluded iff proving the corpus envelope in one direction (the envelope swap fits the collected state, or real exhaustion is proven) needs more than the declared read bound; the bound lets every concentrated pool be walked to MIN_TICK/MAX_TICK, so thinness alone never excludes a pool; a source left without an admitted pool blocks publication

origin.leg_derived: pair and raw amount taken from one historical swap leg (dex.trades row) in the window; a leg is not a reconstructed user order and its endpoints were not reconstructed
origin.state_derived_boundary: amount derived from the frozen pool state (rounding / liquidity boundary of a direct pool); not an empirical trade, report separately from empirical strata

splits.rule: within every (token_in, token_out, stratum) cell the 1 case(s) with the smallest sha256(seed|case_id) are `tuning`, the rest `report`; boundary cases are `report`

strata.definition: rank-based raw input amount bands per sampling unit (one direction of an activity pair, or every leg selling a token for no-direct-pool pairs)

universe.no_direct_rule: up to 4 universe pairs with no admitted pool on any source at the block, ranked by the smaller token distinct-tx count (ties: addresses)
universe.rule: top 12 unordered token pairs (by address) by distinct transactions over the five sources in the window, >= 100 each; the token universe is exactly their tokens
